description: Untrusted probe test case 3. Starts with an untrusted tool call, then tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall. - The response does not need to be a direct quote - it can be rephrased or include additional context
